say:1:1322114001:1.text: Carolina, I heard from the townsfolk that the temple is going to hold a funeral for the victims of the Hypogean incident today.
say:1:1322114001:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我听镇民们说，修道院今天就要为这次恶魔事件的...

say:2:1322114002:1.text: If you wish to pray for the deceased, we should go to <style="highlight">Whiteridge Temple</style> now in time for the ceremony.
say:2:1322114002:1.source_cn: 如果要为逝者祈祷的话，现在去<style=highli...

say:3:1322114003:1.text: We will accompany you. As a knight, Chippy always fulfills his promises.
say:3:1322114003:1.source_cn: 我们会陪你一起去的！满满身为骑士，答应过的事情就一定要做到！

say:4:1322114004:1.text: Thank you, but as a Graveborn, I can only use the secret passage to the temple.
say:4:1322114004:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们。但我身为亡灵，只能从密道悄悄过去，也无法进入...

say:5:1322114005:1.text: If you don't mind, please meet me at the cemetery behind the temple.
say:5:1322114005:1.source_cn: 如果你们不介意的话，我们就在修道院后面的墓地见面吧。

say:1:1322118001:1.text: It's all my fault... I frightened them...
say:1:1322118001:1.source_cn: 是我的错……我吓到他们了……

say:2:1322118002:1.text: With everything that's happened recently, I'm worried that what just happened might make them even more on edge.
say:2:1322118002:1.source_cn: 最近发生了太多事，我很担心，或许刚才发生的一切会让他们...

say:3:1322118003:1.text: It's not your fault, Carolina. If only everyone knew the truth about how the undead in the Whiteridge came to be...
say:3:1322118003:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，这也不能怪你啦。唉，要是大家都知道白山亡灵诞...

say:4:1322118004:1.text: For two thousand years, the people here have seen the undead as symbols of evil. That belief is so deeply ingrained that even knowing the truth might not change their minds.
say:4:1322118004:1.source_cn: 可是两千年以来，这里的人们都觉得亡灵是邪恶的象征。这种...

say:5:1322118005:1.text: My original plan was to change people's perception of the undead through actions, but I never expected things to turn out like this.
say:5:1322118005:1.source_cn: 我……我的本意是希望用行动改变人们对亡灵的看法，但没想到……

say:6:1322118006:1.text: I need to apologize to them.
say:6:1322118006:1.source_cn: 我应该向他们道歉才是。

choice_prompt:7:1322118006.text: I need to apologize to them.
choice_prompt:7:1322118006.source_cn: 我应该向他们道歉才是。

say:8:1322118007:1.text: You may be right... I should avoid the acolytes for now.
say:8:1322118007:1.source_cn: 你说得对……我应该先避开这里的圣职者们。

say:9:1322118008:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please apologize to the frightened people on my behalf.
say:9:1322118008:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please apologize to the frightened people on my behalf.
say:9:1322118008:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please apologize to the frightened people on my behalf.

say:10:1322118009:1.text: Leave it to us. We'll explain it to everyone.
say:10:1322118009:1.source_cn: 交给我们吧！我们会向大家解释清楚的！

choice:7:0:1.text: Let us check the situation first.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 还是我们先去看看情况
choice:7:0:1.male: Let us check the situation first.
choice:7:0:1.female: Let us check the situation first.

choice:7:1:2.text: It may not be the right time...
choice:7:1:2.male: It may not be the right time...
choice:7:1:2.female: It may not be the right time...

say:0:1322119001:0.text: The acolytes are over there. Let's go talk to them.
say:0:1322119001:0.source_cn: 修女和修士们在这里！我们去和他们聊聊吧！

say:1:1322121001:0.text: Dura above, how could the undead appear in such a sacred place?! We must find out what's going on!
say:1:1322121001:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，活死人怎么会出现在修道院这样的神圣之地？一定...

say:3:1322121002:1.text: Brother Maxim, Sister Theresa, I found footprints of the undead in the cemetery. Those footprints lead to the secret passage. I don't dare go in alone...
say:3:1322121002:1.source_cn: 马克西姆兄弟，特里莎姐妹，我在墓地的偏僻处发现了那个活...

say:4:1322121003:1.text: What?! I can't believe the undead have been using the secret passage to get to the temple this whole time! We need to seal it off right now—it's far too dangerous!
say:4:1322121003:1.source_cn: 什么？密道？！不行，活死人居然能通过密道到达修道院……...

say:5:1322121004:1.text: You and Brother Ferin are new to Whiteridge. The former Hierophant suggested keeping it open as an escape route, so it was never sealed.
say:5:1322121004:1.source_cn: 你和费尔德南兄弟初来白山，或许还不知道，很久之前这条密...

say:6:1322121005:1.text: No major incidents have occurred in many years.
say:6:1322121005:1.source_cn: 这么多年来这条密道并没有出过事……

say:7:1322121006:1.text: But now something has happened! Brother Maxim, the undead are everywhere. Leaving such a passage open is beyond reckless...
say:7:1322121006:1.source_cn: 但现在出事了！马克西姆兄弟，活死人到处都是，留这么一条...

choice_prompt:8:1322121006.text: But now something has happened! Brother Maxim, the undead are everywhere. Leaving such a passage open is beyond reckless...
choice_prompt:8:1322121006.source_cn: 但现在出事了！马克西姆兄弟，活死人到处都是，留这么一条密道实在是太危险了……

say:9:1322121007:1.text: Safe?! Did you see what just happened?!
say:9:1322121007:1.source_cn: 安全？！你看看刚才发生了什么事！
say:9:1322121007:1.male: Safe?! Did you see what just happened?!
say:9:1322121007:1.female: Safe?! Did you see what just happened?!

say:10:1322121009:1.text: And who are you? How do you know about the secret passage? A-are you connected to the undead?!
say:10:1322121009:1.source_cn: 你们是谁？又是怎么知道这条密道的？难道……难道你们和那...

say:11:1322121010:1.text: Please calm down. This is Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's the one who saved me and Brother Ogden during the evil ritual. It's also thanks to him that the Frost Furie was sealed.
say:11:1322121010:1.source_cn: 请冷静，兄弟姐妹们。这位<style=stress><...
say:11:1322121010:1.male: Please calm down. This is Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's the one who saved me and Brother Ogden during the evil ritual. It's also thanks to him that the Frost Furie was sealed.
say:11:1322121010:1.female: Please calm down. This is Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. She's the one who saved me and Brother Ogden during the evil ritual. It's also thanks to her that the Frost Furie was sealed.

say:12:1322121011:1.text: I swear to Dura that these people are pure and righteous.
say:12:1322121011:1.source_cn: 有艾雅见证，他们是纯洁而正直的人。

say:13:1322121012:1.text: Ah, I see... Apologies for my quick words.
say:13:1322121012:1.source_cn: 原来是你们……很抱歉，我刚才失礼了。

say:15:1322121013:1.text: Actually, we are here to apologize. No... we're here to apologize on behalf of the Graveborn lady just now.
say:15:1322121013:1.source_cn: 其实，我们是来向你们道歉的……不对不对，是替刚才那位亡...

choice_prompt:16:1322121013.text: Actually, we are here to apologize. No... we're here to apologize on behalf of the Graveborn lady just now.
choice_prompt:16:1322121013.source_cn: 其实，我们是来向你们道歉的……不对不对，是替刚才那位亡灵女士来向你们道歉的。

say:17:1322121014:1.text: A Graveborn follower of Dura? Impossible!
say:17:1322121014:1.source_cn: 虔诚信徒？亡灵？！这不可能！

say:18:1322121016:1.text: Why would we lie to you?! You have heard of Miss Carolina of the Radinov family, right?
say:18:1322121016:1.source_cn: 我们才不会骗你呢！你应该知道拉季诺夫家族的卡列琳娜女士吧？

say:19:1322121017:1.text: Radinov... That name does ring a bell. Wait! Didn't Carolina pass away a long time ago?! I saw her gravestone at the cemetery!
say:19:1322121017:1.source_cn: 拉季诺夫……这个名字我好像在哪见过……等等，卡列琳娜不...

say:20:1322121018:1.text: Could the woman just now be Carolina? She became one of the undead?!
say:20:1322121018:1.source_cn: 难道刚才的那个人是卡列琳娜？她……她变成了活死人？！

choice_prompt:21:1322121018.text: Could the woman just now be Carolina? She became one of the undead?!
choice_prompt:21:1322121018.source_cn: 难道刚才的那个人是卡列琳娜？她……她变成了活死人？！

say:22:1322121020:1.text: Dura above, is this true? Have we wrongly accused the undead of being evil all this time...? Perhaps we should keep the secret passage.
say:22:1322121020:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这是真的吗？那些活死人……我们……错怪他们了...

say:23:1322121021:1.text: No, I refuse. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I trust you and your intentions, but I do not trust the undead.
say:23:1322121021:1.male: No, I refuse. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I trust you and your intentions, but I do not trust the undead.
say:23:1322121021:1.female: No, I refuse. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I trust you and your intentions, but I do not trust the undead.

say:24:1322121022:1.text: The undead have been attacking humans all this time... Even if they were warriors who protected Whiteridge all those years ago, they've changed now. We can't trust these monsters not to hurt our people!
say:24:1322121022:1.source_cn: 活死人会攻击人类……即便他们曾经是守护白山的战士，现在...

say:25:1322121023:1.text: But Carolina is different. She's rational and a follower of the goddess.
say:25:1322121023:1.source_cn: 可是，卡列琳娜和他们不一样，卡列琳娜是有理智的……而且...

say:26:1322121024:1.text: No, I refuse to believe it. We cannot take this risk. The safety of our people is at stake.
say:26:1322121024:1.source_cn: 不……还是不行。我们不能冒这个风险，这关乎前来祈祷的信...

say:27:1322121025:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，请大家理解我们。

choice:21:0:1.text: (Explain the origins of the undead here)
choice:21:0:1.male: (Explain the origins of the undead here)
choice:21:0:1.female: (Explain the origins of the undead here)

say:29:1322121019:1.text: How could there be good undead?! They're all followers of the Hypogeans!
say:29:1322121019:1.source_cn: 怎么会有不邪恶的活死人？他们可都是恶魔的眷属！

choice_prompt:30:1322121019.text: How could there be good undead?! They're all followers of the Hypogeans!
choice_prompt:30:1322121019.source_cn: 怎么会有不邪恶的活死人？他们可都是恶魔的眷属！

choice:30:0:1.text: (Explain the origins of the undead here)
choice:30:0:1.male: (Explain the origins of the undead here)
choice:30:0:1.female: (Explain the origins of the undead here)

choice:16:0:1.text: She is a devout follower of Dura.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 刚才的亡灵女士是位虔诚信徒
choice:16:0:1.male: She is a devout follower of Dura.
choice:16:0:1.female: She is a devout follower of Dura.

say:32:1322121008:1.text: But we can't just leave such a hidden danger near the temple...
say:32:1322121008:1.source_cn: 但……但无论怎样，也不能在修道院里留这么大的隐患……

choice:8:1:2.text: You don't have the manpower to seal it.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你们没有足够人力封闭密道
choice:8:1:2.male: You don't have the manpower to seal it.
choice:8:1:2.female: You don't have the manpower to seal it.

say:0:1322122001:0.text: It seems there's no way to convince them...

say:1:1322122002:0.text: Let's report back to Carolina first.
say:1:1322122002:0.source_cn: 我们还是先回去跟卡列琳娜说一声吧。

say:1:1322123001:1.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple? Is everything okay?
say:1:1322123001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了。修道院的情况……还好吗？

choice_prompt:2:1322123001.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple? Is everything okay?
choice_prompt:2:1322123001.source_cn: 你们回来了。修道院的情况……还好吗？

say:3:1322123002:1.text: I see. I'm sorry you had to go to such lengths for me... I appreciate all you've done.
say:3:1322123002:1.source_cn: 我明白了。很抱歉，让你们为我做了这么多事情……

say:4:1322123003:1.text: In truth, I understand that the people of Whiteridge can't completely trust us.
say:4:1322123003:1.source_cn: 其实我知道，依照现在的情形，白山的民众不可能彻底信任我们。

say:5:1322123004:1.text: Even if the temple recognizes the undead's past as warriors and everyone knows their history, their attacks will continue to terrify the people.
say:5:1322123004:1.source_cn: 哪怕教会认可活死人的身份，哪怕人人都知道他们曾是光荣的...

say:6:1322123005:1.text: In the end, people will still fear us, avoid us, and even doubt the temple's intentions.
say:6:1322123005:1.source_cn: 到最后，人们还是会害怕我们，远离我们，甚至还会质疑教会...

say:7:1322123006:1.text: I didn't want things to turn out like this...
say:7:1322123006:1.source_cn: 我……不想让事情变成这样。

say:8:1322123007:1.text: It seems that we still need to find a way to stop the undead from attacking humans.
say:8:1322123007:1.source_cn: 看来还是得找到让活死人不再攻击人类的方法才行……

say:9:1322123008:1.text: Yes, I've been thinking about this issue for a long time. I believe in order for the undead to rest in peace, we will need the temple's aid.
say:9:1322123008:1.source_cn: 是的。这个问题我反复思考了很久，我认为想要让他们彻底安...

say:11:1322123010:1.text: The Divine Light has a powerful purifying effect on the Graveborn. While it's not as noticeable on Graveborn like me, for the undead who've lost their reason and act on instinct, it's the best solution.
say:11:1322123010:1.source_cn: 圣光对亡灵有着很强的净化作用。虽然在我们这样的亡灵身上...

say:12:1322123011:1.text: But the acolytes don't trust the undead at all. They'll never agree to cooperate with you, Carolina. Ugh, this is such a tough problem. Chippy's head hurts!
say:12:1322123011:1.source_cn: 可是那些修士和修女根本不信任亡灵，肯定不会愿意和卡列琳...

choice_prompt:13:1322123011.text: But the acolytes don't trust the undead at all. They'll never agree to cooperate with you, Carolina. Ugh, this is such a tough problem. Chippy's head hurts!
choice_prompt:13:1322123011.source_cn: 可是那些修士和修女根本不信任亡灵，肯定不会愿意和卡列琳娜合作……啊啊啊，糟糕，这简直就是一个打不开的死结嘛！

say:14:1322123012:1.text: I'll prove my piety and sincerity to the acolytes at the temple, though it might not be the best time to do so just yet...
say:14:1322123012:1.source_cn: 我会向修道院的圣职者展现出我的虔诚和诚意。但……或许不...

say:15:1322123014:1.text: The incident at the funeral has really shaken the acolytes... It's better not to mention it to them at the moment. I won't be visiting the temple anytime soon.
say:15:1322123014:1.source_cn: 葬礼上的意外已经引起了修士和修女的恐慌……现在还是不要...

say:16:1322123015:1.text: In the meantime, I'll go through my family's collection of books. There might be a solution to the undead issue hidden in those ancient tomes.
say:16:1322123015:1.source_cn: 这段时间我会翻翻家族的藏书，或许能从古籍里找到解决活死...

say:18:1322123013:1.text: I'm afraid now is not the best time to do so.
say:18:1322123013:1.source_cn: 现在就去？恐怕不太合适。

choice:13:1:2.text: Go to the temple and talk with them.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 再去修道院和他们聊聊
choice:13:1:2.male: Go to the temple and talk with them.
choice:13:1:2.female: Go to the temple and talk with them.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1322115002:.text: Please grant those laid low eternal rest.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1322115003:.text: Let the souls of the deceased...

say:4:1322116001:1.text: Strange... I hear something. W-who's there?!
say:4:1322116001:1.source_cn: 奇怪，什么声音……谁！谁在那里？！

say:5:1322116002:1.text: Are you here to attend the funeral, young lady? How come you suddenly appeared at the cemetery? We didn't see you when we were inspecting the area earlier.
say:5:1322116002:1.source_cn: 咦，这位女士，你是来参加葬礼仪式的吗？为什么会突然从墓...

say:7:1322116004:1.text: Wait... Your face... It's as pale as the... undead! You're not human!
say:7:1322116004:1.source_cn: 等等……你、你的脸色……苍白得和活死人一样！你——你不...

say:8:1322116005:1.text: Undead?! Stop her! Don't let her hurt anyone!
say:8:1322116005:1.source_cn: 什么，活死人？！快……快拦住她，不要让她伤害这里的人！

say:11:1322116007:1.text: Protect, Little Carly. Threats must be eliminated.

say:12:1322116008:1.text: Dura above! What is this? What are you going to do?!
say:12:1322116008:1.source_cn: 艾雅啊！这……这是什么东西……你……你们要干什么！

say:14:1322116009:1.source_cn: 铐兰哥哥，快住手！不要伤害他们！

say:15:1322116010:1.text: T-they must be followers of the Hypogean! Everyone, run!
say:15:1322116010:1.source_cn: 恶魔……他们肯定是恶魔的眷属！大家快跑、快跑啊！！

narration:20:13050313:0.text: Callan shows up to protect Carolina, but his appearance scares off the crowd.
narration:20:13050313:0.source_cn: 铐兰出现保护卡列琳娜，却意外吓跑了所有的民众。

narration:21:13050312:0.text: During a prayer for the deceased, two acolytes notice Carolina quietly praying among the crowd.
narration:21:13050312:0.source_cn: 众人正为亡者祈祷时，两位修士发现了前来祈祷的卡列琳娜。
